Load [github-actions](../skills/github-actions/SKILL.md). Create or verify one
matrix job for Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS using Python 3.13, the required
triggers, the platform CI scripts, and downloadable per-OS artifacts. Preserve
unrelated workflows and stop on incompatible configuration.
